chart_review_items.title: Clarify filter scope and inline legend behavior
chart_review_items.current_state: Standalone legend filters; line legend is static. Table/Rows search and filtering have different scopes.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Users can distinguish visual hiding, local search, and global filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Line legend supports hide/isolate with visible state.
Hiding a series is not silently treated as filtering source rows.
Global/local scope is labeled where controls are used.
Promoting a local predicate to the workspace is an explicit action when supported.
Standalone categorical/date filter controls reuse existing predicates.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Explain exactly which population a view represents
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Active counts, local Rows/search labels and owner navigation are active. Chart traces describe additional populations and exclusions.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: No universal row-exclusion explanation or ordered filter funnel is established. Peer-filtered mark totals can legitimately differ from global row totals.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Keep persistent base constraints and independent filter groups
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Independent workspace instances are a host composition option.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: No in-workspace filter islands or stable base-filter layer is established. Do not interpret peer filtering as independent filter groups.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Typed categorical legend filtering is described.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Continuous legend brushing and linked hover emphasis are not established as general contracts. A visible color ramp is not interactive numerical selection.
